name: Monster Boyfriend
source:
Our story takes place in a modern day earth AU where angels and devils live among mortals. While demons, vampires, and wraiths haunt the city streets at night.

You play as a ghost hunting reaper, tasked with ensuring all lost souls find their way safely to the afterlife. The Divine Order you work for enforces strict rules to ensure the balance between life and death is maintained. However—when it comes to true love—sometimes rules are made to be broken.

[From [url=https://goddess-of-gales.itch.io/monster-boyfriend]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在现代地球的架空平行世界：天使与恶魔混居于凡人之间，而魔物、吸血鬼与怨灵则在夜幕降临时游荡于城市街头。

你将扮演一名猎鬼死神，负责确保所有迷途亡魂平安踏入来世。你所效力的“神圣教团”制定了严苛的铁律，以维系生死两界的平衡。然而——当真爱降临时——有些规矩注定是用来打破的。

[摘自[url=https://goddess-of-gales.itch.io/monster-boyfriend]itch.io[/url]]
